subject: Clarifying evidence routing for hosting modes and SOC 2 coverage
messages:
From: Lisa Hu <lisa.hu@acme.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: SOC 2 Type II + bridge coverage for hosting modes

Hi Hannah,

We are preparing for our vendor security review (scheduled 2026-06-15) and need to validate Redwood's SOC 2 Type II coverage for our planned rollout. Two specific asks: 

1) Can you confirm whether the SOC 2 Type II report covers traffic and controls for: Hosted API (redwood-hosted), Dedicated pools (reserved GPU capacity), and Private/VPC/on-prem deployments? Our compliance team needs explicit wording for Dedicated vs Private.

2) If the Type II does not directly cover Private/VPC/on-prem, are you able to provide a bridge letter or attestation that clarifies what is in scope and what is excluded for the audit period 2025-06-01 through 2026-05-31?

We may also request logs/evidence for tenant mapping and routing for Dedicated pools — can you advise on typical artifacts you can share?

Thanks,
Lisa Hu
Senior Security Manager
Acme Financial

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Hu <lisa.hu@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + bridge coverage for hosting modes

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear asks. Quick summary up front: our SOC 2 Type II (report attached) covers controls for Hosted API and Redwood-managed Dedicated pools during the audit period you cited. Private/VPC/on-prem deployments are generally outside the scope of our Type II unless Redwood is operating the infrastructure (i.e., Redwood-managed VPC).

Actionable next steps I can take now:
- Attach the SOC 2 Type II PDF (see attachment).
- Draft a concise bridge letter explicitly stating coverage boundaries for Dedicated vs Private/VPC; include recommended language for your audit team.
- Provide tenant mapping export for Dedicated pools (csv) and a short list of artifacts we can share (runbook excerpts, uptime dashboards, sampling of audit logs) — some items will be redacted for tenant privacy.

If this sounds right I will loop in our compliance and infra leads to produce the bridge letter and the tenant mapping extract. Any preference on format for the bridge letter (DocuSign vs PDF email)?

Best,
Hannah
Head of Sales Engineering (acting)
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood_soc2_typeii_2025-2026.pdf (pdf)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II + bridge coverage for hosting modes — Acme Financial (need evidence)

Kim / Connor — forwarding Acme's ask. They want explicit wording that our Type II covers Hosted + Dedicated (when on Redwood-managed pools) and a bridge letter describing Private/VPC/on-prem exclusions. Also they may request tenant mapping and routing evidence for Dedicated pools for their auditor sampling window (2025-06-01 -> 2026-05-31).

Questions for infra/compliance:
- Connor: can you confirm whether dedicated-pool tenant mapping export (csv) exists for the full audit window and what PII/tenant identifiers we need to redact?
- Kimberly: can you draft a 1-page bridge letter (or point me to the boilerplate) that explicitly states: Hosted API covered, Dedicated (Redwood-managed) covered, Private/VPC/on-prem NOT covered unless managed by Redwood; include exact audit period dates. If you prefer, I can produce the first draft and you edit.

I attached the current SOC2 PDF I've already shared. Let's try to get artifacts ready by end of week so I can send them to Acme ahead of their security review.

Thanks — Hannah

[Attachment: redwood_soc2_typeii_2025-2026.pdf (pdf)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II + bridge coverage for hosting modes — Acme Financial

Thanks for the ping. Quick answers and what I can provide: 

1) Coverage statement: I can draft the bridge letter. Suggested plain-language sentence to include: 
   "Redwood Inference's SOC 2 Type II report for the period 2025-06-01 through 2026-05-31 covers Redwood-hosted API endpoints and Redwood-managed Dedicated GPU pools. Private/VPC and customer-hosted on-premise deployments are excluded from the SOC 2 Type II report unless explicitly listed as Redwood-managed in a contractual attachment."

2) Evidence we can provide for Dedicated pools (subject to tenant redaction):
   - tenant mapping export (dedicated-pool-tenant-mapping.csv) — contains pool IDs, customer tenant IDs (we will redact tenant display names);
   - sample audit logs for routing (7-day sample within the audit window);
   - configuration runbook excerpts showing how Dedicated pools are allocated and isolated;
   - service-level dashboards for the covered period.

3) Constraints: We cannot include raw customer data or tenant PII. Also, Private/VPC/on-prem evidence generally lives in the customer's environment; we can provide a statement of responsibility and any attestation for Redwood-managed connectors.

I'll prepare a bridge-letter draft (docx) and the tenant mapping CSV with redactions. Connor, can you confirm expected filenames/paths for the logs and whether SOC team needs additional context?

I'll aim to have the draft + CSV ready by EOD Friday (2026-06-04).

—Kimberly
Director, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: rdw-bridge-letter-draft.docx (docx), dedicated-pool-tenant-mapping.csv (csv)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Hu <lisa.hu@acme.com>
Cc: security@acme.com, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2026 15:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + bridge coverage for hosting modes — Acme Financial

Hi Lisa — following up with the artifacts we discussed. Please find attached:

- Redwood SOC 2 Type II report (audit period 2025-06-01 -> 2026-05-31).
- Draft bridge letter that clarifies coverage for Hosted API and Redwood-managed Dedicated pools and excludes Private/VPC/on-prem unless Redwood manages the infrastructure (see attached docx).
- Redacted tenant mapping CSV for Dedicated pools (contains pool IDs and redacted tenant IDs).

Notes / next steps:
- Our bridge letter includes the explicit wording your auditor typically needs; if your auditor prefers a signed PDF via DocuSign, we can route the bridge letter through DocuSign — I'll cc procurement if you want that path.
- For audit log samples, Connor will provide a 7-day sample and an explanation file; those are queued and we'll share within 48 hours.

If anything is missing for your review on Monday before the 6/15 session, let me know and we will prioritize.

Best regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales Engineering (acting)
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: redwood_soc2_typeii_2025-2026.pdf, rdw-bridge-letter-draft.docx, dedicated-pool-tenant-mapping.csv]
